caption: The drawing depicts a single jug or pitcher with a decorative handle and ornate surface designs. The jug is light brown with shading that suggests a ceramic or clay texture. The handle is sculpted to resemble an animal, possibly a bird or a dolphin, with its head attached to the rim and its tail at the body of the jug. Around the upper portion of the jug, there is a relief pattern of grape vines and leaves. The lower section features a more detailed relief scene, possibly depicting a figure or animal beneath a tree with foliage. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and there is a signature “M. Eoltmann” in red at the bottom right near the base of the jug.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
